title: The Fixer
text: Every policy you touch pays out twice — the bill, and the kickback.

title: The Operator
text: The votes are yours whenever you decide to spend them. Efficiency is patience.

title: The Benefactor
text: A gift to a rival, and a quiet appointment of your own. Charity is leverage.

title: The Backer
text: You back two horses. When they run, you collect either way.

title: The Agitator
text: Chaos comes cheap when you know exactly which nerve to strike.

title: The Spinner
text: You don't wait for the news. You write it, and you aim it.

title: The Organizer
text: Nothing is whispered that you don't already hear. Every hand is an open hand.

title: The Informant
text: Play dirty near you and lose a foot soldier. Play clean, and you gain the crowd.

title: The Oracle
text: Sacrifice a follower, and the faithful reward you threefold.

title: The Insurgent
text: Your cadres melt across borders overnight, wherever the front demands.

title: The Enforcer
text: Everyone who governs pays you a cut. It is simply the cost of doing politics.

title: The Strongman
text: Cross into your territory and you belong to it. Resistance is re-registration.

title: The Maverick
text: Loyal to no single creed, you borrow whatever power the moment requires.
